source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 34 — NORTHERN GATES OF HEAVEN — **GE'EZ IS THE ONLY COMPLETE WITNESS; Akhmim Greek not preserved; Aramaic 4Q205/4Q206 only sparse fragments.**

verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ሰሜናተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወህየ፡ ርእኩ፡ ግብረ፡ ዐቢየ፡ ወክቡረ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጽንፈ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmhəya ḥorku mangala samēnāta ʾaṣnāfa mədr wa-həya rəʾku gəbra ʿabəya wa-kəbura ba-kwəlu ṣənfa kwəlu mədr
verses.notes: Enoch journeys to the northern ends of the earth — sees a great and glorious work at the cosmic boundary.

verses.text_geez: ወህየ፡ ርእኩ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ሰማይ፡ ክሥቱተ፡ በሰማይ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወነፋስ፡
verses.translit: wa-həya rəʾku śalastu ʾanāqəḍa samāy kəśtuta ba-samāy ʾəmənnehomu yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-nafās
verses.notes: **Three gates of heaven open in the north — from which dew, rain, and wind go forth.** The cosmic-meteorology of the three northern gates. The triad of dew/rain/wind reflects the agricultural-cosmology. Cross-corpus: Job 38:22 ('storehouses of snow and hail'); Job 37:9 ('from the south comes the storm, and cold from the scattering winds').

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ አሐዱ፡ አንቀጽ፡ ይነፍኅ፡ ለሠናይት፡ ወአመ፡ ይነፍኁ፡ እምነ፡ ካልአን፡ አናቅጽ፡ በጽንዕ፡ ወምክፍልት፡ ይከውን፡ ምድር፡ ወይነፍኁ፡ በዕውሬ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmənna ʾaḥadu ʾanqəḍ yənaffəḫ la-śannāyt wa-ʾama yənaffəḫu ʾəmənna kāləʾān ʾanāqəḍ ba-ṣənʿ wa-məkfəlt yəkawwən mədr wa-yənaffəḫu ba-ʿəwrē
verses.notes: From one gate blow winds for good; from the others, winds with violence and distress upon the earth, blowing harmfully. The wind-as-divine-agent-of-judgment motif. Cross-corpus: Jer 49:36 (the four winds of judgment); Rev 7:1 (four angels holding the four winds).
